title: Summer Tape / Session 04
summary: Late night session recorded directly from the hardware mixer. House grooves, 80s tape compression, and unreleased cuts.
content:
This session came together over a weekend exploring FM synth patches and analog chorus effects. Everything was multitracked through vintage hardware before running to 1/4-inch tape.

Tracklist highlights include early sketches of the upcoming EP alongside edits of classic electro cuts.

title: Open Source: Web Audio Visualizer
summary: A lightweight canvas-based oscilloscope and FFT spectrum analyzer built with the Web Audio API.
content:
I built a tiny, zero-dependency browser oscilloscope to visualize audio streams with 60fps smoothing. Tested with both microphone input and HTML5 audio elements.

The project is fully open source under the MIT license.

title: Setting Up Shop
summary: A new minimal home on the web for archiving tracks, publishing thoughts, and sharing project repos.
content:
Decided to carve out a clean, distraction-free corner of the web. This space will serve as a hub for both audio releases and code experiments.

Hosted statically on GCP with custom domain routing.
